title: Add accountId to Scene ephemeral event types
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[scene] Add accountId to Scene ephemeral event types
Spec (9d02170): draft-atwood-jmap-scene-wss-00.md L178: "Every event carries an `accountId` (String) property: the id of the region's hosting account ... SceneRegion and SceneObject ids are unique only within an account, so `regionId` alone does not identify a region."
Code: crate-jmap-scene-types/src/event.rs:59; crate-jmap-scene-types/src/event.rs:84; crate-jmap-scene-types/src/event.rs:114; crate-jmap-scene-types/src/event.rs:137-148; crate-jmap-scene-server/src/ephemeral.rs:182-188
Now: SceneAvatarEvent, SceneObjectEvent and SceneInteractionEvent have no account_id field. A wire accountId lands in `extra` and is never required. should_deliver takes account_id as a separate argument that is never cross-checked against the event.
Change: Add `account_id: Id` to all three event structs and to SceneInteractionEvent::new. should_deliver should use the event's accountId, or reject a mismatch. Update the doc examples and the wss spec example tests to the new examples.
